import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n, m, s, t = int(input_data[0]), int(input_data[1]), int(input_data[2]) - 1, int(input_data[3])
    t = int(input_data[4])
    # Adjust t to be divisible by n
    while t % n != 0:
        if s < m:
            s = (s + t) % n
        else:
            s = (s - t) % n
        t -= 1
    t //= n
    seen = [-1] * n
    seen[s] = 0
    count = 0
    while t > 0:
        count += 1
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < m:
                s = (s + i) % n
            else:
                s = (s - i) % n
        if seen[s] != -1:
            t %= (count - seen[s])
        seen[s] = count
        t -= 1
    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
